column3:
Ferah — a disk cleaner for macOS
  Ferah                        opens the app
  Ferah --tara-json            prints the Step 1 category scan as JSON (read-only)
  Ferah --buyuk-json [--esik MB]
                               prints large-file candidates with explanations as JSON (read-only)
  Ferah --uygulamalar-json     prints installed apps with usage and leftover data as JSON (read-only)
  Ferah --sistem-json          prints the "System Data" breakdown as JSON (read-only)
  Ferah --oz-sinama            runs the safety and deletion tests in a temporary folder
  Ferah --akis-sinama          sets up a demo home in a temporary folder and drives the app's view model end to end
  Ferah --deneme-evi-kur FOLDER
                               builds a realistic fake home in FOLDER inside the temporary directory
  Ferah --deneme-evi FOLDER    opens the app on that fake home only (your real files are never touched)
In every mode:
  --dil tr|en                  forces the language (default: in-app choice, otherwise the system language)
App flags:
  --tema acik|koyu             forces light or dark appearance
  --ac-ve-tara, --ac-buyuk, --ac-uygulamalar, --ac-sistem
                               starts a read-only scan at launch
  --adim N                     opens step N (1–5) at launch
  --pencere WxH                window size (e.g. 900x620)
  --deneme-onay                (demo mode only) shows a confirmation dialog at launch
  --her-masaustu               (demo mode only) the window shows on every Space; for driving it through Accessibility
